svg.title: The vision encoder brings information across patches
svg.desc: Input U has rows A,B,C,D with four components each. Two vision blocks containing self-attention and FFN produce Z with rows z_A,z_B,z_C,z_D. The enlargement shows Q_A reading KV_A,KV_B,KV_C,KV_D, then residual and FFN processing yield the one-block output u′_A. Final Z is passed to the next article’s language-model connector.
